notes.title: v0.70.0
notes.notes:
Gameplay

[list][*] Archon class: Psi-shockwave[list][*] Now stuns overseers on hit for 0.75 s[list][*] Overseers only partially in the psi-shockwave on hit will be stunned for only a portion of the full duration[*] Stun interrupts blink cast[/list][*] Decrease minimum cast delay (600 ms -> 500 ms)[*] Increase travel speed (2.16 m/s -> 2.28 m/s)[*] Increase rate of expansion (expansion half-life: 0.8 s -> 0.75 s)[/list][*] Phantom class: Blink[list][*] Place the drones in a tighter formation during teleportation[list][*] The 6-drone formation is unchanged[/list][/list][*] Team Deathmatch mode[list][*] Reduce respawn time (8 s -> 6 s)[/list][/list]

Bots

[list][*] Make psi-shockwaves deter bots from pursuing enemy overseers[/list]

Fixes

[list][*] Fix random crashes during multiplayer games, probably[/list]

notes.title: v0.69.0
notes.notes:
New

[list][*] Add prototype for new player class: Phantom[list][*] Intended to be a close-range assassin[*] Ability: Blink[list][*] Teleport you and your drones to the target position after a brief delay[*] Movement control is disabled during the delay[*] Heal drones for a small amount on teleport[/list][/list][/list]

Misc

[list][*] Player stats: Record damage dealt to drones[/list]

notes.title: v0.68.0
notes.notes:
New

[list][*] Initial implementation of Team Deathmatch game mode[list][*] Available in single player mode[*] Available in multiplayer mode if the server operator changes the “misc_gameMode” parameter from “ctf” to “tdm”[/list][/list]

Gameplay

[list][*] Decrease drone maneouverability[list][*] Decrease drone acceleration by ~5% while maintaining drone terminal velocity[*] This partially reverts the increase in the last update[/list][*] Reduce minimum delay between overseer dashes (250 ms -> 225 ms)[/list]

Audio

[list][*] Adjust SFX for psi-shockwave activation[/list]

Bots

[list][*] Have templar bots attempt to psi-storm enemy overseers if it would be lethal[*] Back off from pursuing a headbutt kill when at a disadvantage and unlikely to get the kill quickly[*] Refine logic for avoiding drones with dash charge[*] Stay a bit further away from psi-shockwaves to avoid getting clipped[*] Fix a bug where bots would sometimes not cast psi-storm defensively for allies if they were not templar class[*] Fix a bug where bots would sometimes hold a drone dash charge forever if they were targeting you and you didn’t move enough[/list]

Misc

[list][*] Allow class selection at the start of new rounds[/list]

notes.notes:
Gameplay

notes.notes:

notes.title: v0.52.0
notes.notes:
Bots

[list][*] Overseer movement[list][*] Significantly improve overseer movement[*] Fix issue where low-level bots would endlessly circle around flags and other small targets[/list][*] Drone movement[list][*] Add latency to drone movements[*] Better position drones to block enemy drones when defending self and allied overseers[*] Ignore psi-storms when pursuing enemy overseers with healthy drones[/list][*] Overseer dash[list][*] Be more careful when trying to headbutt enemy overseers with overseer dash[/list][/list]

notes.title: v0.51.0
notes.notes:
Bots

[list][*] Overseer dash[list][*] Replace placeholder overseer dash logic with a proper implementation[/list][*] Drone repel[list][*] Use drone repel to attack a target when using drone attract isn’t feasible[/list][*] Overseer movement[list][*] Don’t maintain spacing from allies during significant advantage or disadvantage[*] Avoid being too close to the game world boundary[*] Avoid pursuing enemies that are already being pursued by multiple allies[*] Avoid escorting the flag carrier if they are not threatened[*] Be less willing to pick up enemy flags further from home base when threatened[*] Fix a bug where overseers would approach but fail to move into a flag or flag recovery area[/list][/list]

notes.title: v0.50.0
notes.notes:
Bots

[list][*] Drone movement[list][*] Acquire and pursue overseer targets more decisively[*] Sometimes defend self and allied overseers when pressured[*] Improve maneuvering of drones around psionic storms[*] Charge drone dash if drones are already at the desired position[/list][*] Psionic storm[list][*] Cast psionic storm more accurately and decisively[*] Fix bug in psionic storm casting conditions that prevented casting psionic storm even under high pressure[/list][*] Overseer movement[list][*] Maintain more spacing from allied overseers[*] Try more aggressively to headbutt weaker enemy overseers[*] Improve opportunistic gathering of shield powerups[*] Seek shield powerups at the mid-map shield powerup spawners[*] Improve decision making around when to pick up and drop flags[*] When carrying the flag, be more avoidant of enemies[*] When carrying the flag, be more aggressive during periods of team advantage[*] Steal flags from the enemy base more opportunistically[*] Fix a bug where overseers would sometimes would not try to reclaim a dropped allied flag[*] Fix a bug where two allied overseers would get stuck both trying to pick up the same flag[*] Fix a bug where an overseer would get stuck trying to pick up an shield powerup at the cusp between two obstacles[/list][/list]

Misc

[list][*] Move team spawn areas from the bottom-left and top-right of the map to the top-left and bottom-right, respectively[/list]
